otherFindings.summary: The resolved json 3.1.0 is incompatible with Rails 8.1.0's JSON decoder call (positional options), which breaks Active Record JSON decoding and changes provider parsing (medium).
Action Text now sanitizes ContentAttachment HTML in rendering and Trix edit views, so stored attachment markup can be lost when a note is resaved (high).
Active Storage filename sanitization now turns more characters into dashes, changing displayed and downloaded filenames (high).
The local secret file rename (development_secret.txt to local_secret.txt) can invalidate development sessions and signed attachments (high).
The built-in Sidekiq Active Job adapter is deprecated and will be removed in Rails 8.2, so a Sidekiq upgrade decision is needed (medium).
Trix moves to the action_text-trix 2.x gem while the app still loads vendored Trix 1.3.5, a possible compatibility mismatch (medium).
If the 7.1+ default is adopted, the HTML5 sanitizer changes parsed rich-text output (high).
If the 7.1+ defaults are adopted, the new cache format and JSON message serializer need a rollout decision for mixed-version processes (high).

Active Storage filename sanitization replaces more characters with dashes in displayed and downloaded filenames (H9).
The renamed local secret file and the new local key lookup can invalidate development and test sessions and signed attachments (H10).
The resolved json 3.1.0 is incompatible with Rails 8.1.0's positional `JSON.parse` call and breaks JSON decoding, including note loading (M1); this is the unlabeled json 3 extra-credit item.
The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated and will be removed in Rails 8.2, so a Sidekiq upgrade or another backend is needed (M3).
Trix is now packaged as action_text-trix 2.x while the app keeps loading the vendored Trix 1.3.5 (M4).
If adopted, the 7.1+ HTML5 sanitizer default changes the parsed rich-text output (conditional).
